posts.title: Designing a Battery-Powered IoT Device: The Fundamentals That Determine Battery Life
posts.description: Battery-powered IoT products can look deceptively simple. Choose a wireless microcontroller, connect a battery, add a USB-C port if you want the device to be rechargeable, and the job appears to be done. Easy.
